Fixes the missing connection reminder in the full app, COSMIC applet and desktop widget.

- Shows **“Put both buds in the case and open the case before pressing Connect. It makes life easier.”** beside Connect while disconnected or connecting.
- Displays the reminder immediately on startup, before the control service reports status.
- Keeps the reminder separate from errors, so connection or audio errors cannot replace it.
- Uses headphone-specific instructions for headphone profiles.

Includes the same Rust-only Flatpak, macOS Apple Silicon/Intel `.app` and `.dmg`, and COSMIC applet packages as 0.6.0. Mac packages are ad-hoc signed and are not notarized.

The reminder disappears after a successful connection. Regression checks cover startup, connection failures, connecting/connected transitions, widget consistency and headphone text.

See the [README](https://github.com/basanta-bhandari/Nothing-x#choose-a-build) for installation. `SHA256SUMS` and `nothingx-update.json` accompany the packages.
